svg.title: Experience: Data Analyst Intern, Bosch Automotive Electronics, manufacturing digitalisation, June to December 2024. Three teams kept separate manual KPI reports for the same floor. I ran discovery with 8 plus line engineers and quality leads, then built unified Tableau dashboards with an automated Python ETL over Oracle SQL and HiveQL, and four reliability KPIs (MTTR, MTBF, technical availability, technical loss). Results: 3 teams adopted the dashboards within 3 weeks; about 85 percent less recurring manual reporting (about 10 hours a week, estimated); 15 plus machines across 5 production lines; contributed to an 18 percent reduction in unplanned downtime. Skills. Product: discovery, user research, PRDs, MVP scoping, RICE, roadmapping, North Star metrics, A/B experiments, teardowns. Data: SQL, Oracle SQL, HiveQL, Hadoop, Python and Pandas, ETL, Tableau, Power BI, KPI design. AI: LLM applications, RAG and retrieval, prompt engineering, evaluation, guardrails, embeddings, sentiment and theme analysis. Development: Git, REST APIs, FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Next.js, TypeScript, SQLite, Firestore, Docker, Pytest, Vitest, GitHub Actions. Education: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, VIT Bhopal, 2021 to 2025; NextLeap Product Management Fellowship, Cohort 47.
